desc: Implement the LCS-row transition for appending each lowercase character to the current candidate prefix.
Enumerate all reachable DP rows from the all-zero row and assign compact state indices.
Build transition multiplicities for every reachable state, merging letters with identical destinations.
Run \(M\) iterations of state-count DP modulo 998244353.
Aggregate final counts by the last DP-row entry and print answers for \(k=0,\ldots,N\).
Validate the implementation against all provided samples.
